concept: EventBridge: content-based routing, SaaS sources, archive/replay
tests: Choosing an event bus service for content-based routing from AWS, custom, and SaaS sources with archive and replay.
expected: Amazon EventBridge: rules on event content, partner event sources (Datadog, etc.), AWS service events, archive and replay. Triggers: "third-party SaaS", "based on event content", "archive and replay".
why_not: SNS does fan-out but lacks rich rules, SaaS sources, and replay; SQS is a point-to-point queue; Step Functions orchestrates workflows, it does not route events.
